scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.clean: rm -rf server/dist client/dist node_modules server/node_modules client/node_modules packages/node_modules
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:client: wait-on http://localhost:8000/api/v1/health && npm run dev -w client
scripts.lint: concurrently -n client,server -c blue,green "npm run lint -w client" "npm run lint -w server"
scripts.start: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm start -w server" "npm run preview -w client"
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w server
